title: DeepSeek-R1 Thoughtology: Let’s think about LLM reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to moral dilemmas (Defining Issues Test) and the LLM-GLOBE benchmark across different languages to assess alignment with specific cultural values (e.g., collectivism, power distance).
Comparing the length, structure, and underlying values of the model's reasoning chains when prompted in English, Chinese, and Hindi to observe language-dependent adaptations and preferences.
Evaluated as one of the nine cultural dimensions (Gender Egalitarianism) within the LLM-GLOBE benchmark by analyzing open-ended generations across languages.
